verdict.rationale: stagewise is documented as a standalone desktop IDE (macOS/Windows/Linux downloads) with interactive chat, diff review, and browser preview. Nothing in the evidence shows a headless mode, a CI integration, or a non-interactive invocation of its agents. A community mention of signing up via a CLI concerns account creation, not headless automation, and the agent's shell access is an in-app capability; neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
